items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And when it got to me, he fluffed me off. You know. And he fluffed me off because I was Negro.

ctx.x: And when it got to me, he fluffed me off. You know. And he fluffed me off because I was Negro. Things like that, you know. So, but mother – We said that, but my mother always told me you took a person the way they are. You know. And I never heard my mother say this white that or this Chinese that, or this – She never said any of those things. And as far as my like having a wife or anything, my mother always told me whoever I loved it was okay with her. I mean, we just never spoke about like –
